liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Foolish Heart** (2 reviews): Garcia's lyrics on Foolish Heart were painful, as he only found his vocal footing at Don't Ease Me In; Jerry rips through Foolish Heart to close the set [11][18]
- **Drums** (2 reviews): The Rhythm Devils drum segment features prominent kick drum work that fans of it will enjoy; Drums and space were where the band really shone, and the reviewer says to hear those if nothing else [10][13]
- **Mississippi Half-Step Toodleoo** (1 review): Jerry's voice is back to normal here, and he finds some gold in the outro jam [12]
- **Little Red Rooster** (1 review): Brent contributed an added verse to Little Red Rooster, and he and Bobby sang well [11]
- **Terrapin Station** (1 review): Terrapin Station is singled out as one of the show's high points [9]
- **Throwing Stones** (1 review): A mosh pit formed in the crowd during Throwing Stones [18]
- **Knockin' on Heaven's Door** (1 review): The western skies lyric in Knockin' on Heaven's Door felt especially significant to the listener [20]

## Setlist highlights

- **ambiance**: back after 566 archived shows (2858 days); mythic rare: 2 archived performances [21]

## The recordings

- **gd1988-08-28.140488.sonywmd3.flac1644** (recommended): source not stated; 19 songs; 147 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1988-08-28.163899.ultramatrix.miller.flac2496**: soundboard; 17 songs; 152 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [2]
- **gd88-08-28.sbd.ladner.31107.sbeok.flacf**: soundboard; 18 songs; 150 min; rated 2.96/5 by 28 [3]. Said about its sound: The recording is very clean and dry, with Phil's bass lines coming through well; The recording captures the huge Autzen Stadium space admirably [11][17]
- **gd1988-08-28.164247.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.t.flac1644**: soundboard; 18 songs; 152 min [4]
- **gd1988-08-28.152080.fob.nak700.severson.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 18 songs; 149 min [5]
- **gd88-08-28.sbd.wiley.16085.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 18 songs; 143 min; rated 2.75/5 by 4 [7]. Said about its sound: The recording is heavy on vocals, so Weir's vocal problems are hard to overlook [9]

## Around the show

- Weir's voice was in poor shape, and the playing was loose and sloppy [9]
- Mydland's voice was struggling during the show [10]
- The show took place on a sunny Sunday afternoon and was fun to attend [13]
- Jimmy Cliff, possibly with another act, opened; it was a beautiful day [15]
- The crowd was mostly veteran, rather jaded California heads, and people milled about on the 50 yard line during the show [15]
- Brent looked haggard and dark all show, with black eyes [17]
- Just east of the soundboard, a veiled bride and a tie-dyed groom exchanged wedding vows [18]
- It was nearly 100 degrees, with water sprayed on the field, naked people running through it, and topless women about [20]
- Jerome's vocal quality is close to New Years Eve 1987, though still not great [10]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1988-08-28.140488.sonywmd3.flac1644**: taped by Slipkid68; transferred by JEMS; source: Sony WM-D3 with stock mic > Maxell XL-II 90 minute cassette > Nakamichi CR-7A azimuth-adjusted playback > Sound Devices USBPre2 > Audacity 2.0 (16/44.1 capture… [1]. Also: This is described as a master recording, with a Sony WMD3 source [1]
- **gd1988-08-28.163899.ultramatrix.miller.flac2496**: taped by Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  March 6, 2023; source: Ultramatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-XG) [2]
- **gd88-08-28.sbd.ladner.31107.sbeok.flacf**: transferred by C. Ladner; source: Soundboard [3]
- **gd1988-08-28.164247.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.t.flac1644**: taped by Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  March 6, 2023; source: Ultramatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-XG) [4]
- **gd1988-08-28.152080.fob.nak700.severson.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Mark Severson; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Mark Severson's Master (FOB) Audience Cassettes; Nakamichi 700 mics > Sony D5M [5]
- **gd88-08-28.sbd.wiley.16085.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by T. Wiley; source: Soundboard [7]

- Poster by gocollect.com: [Grateful Dead Autzen Stadium 1988 Value - GoCollect](https://gocollect.com/concert-poster/grateful-dead-autzen-stadium-1988) [22]
- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Autzen Stadium - August 28, 1988](https://www.dead.net/show/august-28-1988) [23]
